title: Delete and Earn
summary: Given an integer array nums, select any element to delete and earn its value in points.
statement: Given an integer array nums, select any element to delete and earn its value in points. After deleting, also remove all elements that are one less or one more than the deleted element. Calculate the maximum points that can be earned by repeating this operation.
constraints: Taking value x earns x and deletes every x-1 and x+1; maximize total points.
hints: After grouping equal values, adjacent numeric values form the same recurrence as nonadjacent house robbery.
Sweep sorted values with best totals for taking or skipping the previous value.
If consecutive, take=current gain+old skip; otherwise add gain to old best.
Grouped choices conflict exactly when their values differ by one, so the two-state recurrence covers every valid subset.
editorial: Grouped choices conflict exactly when their values differ by one, so the two-state recurrence covers every valid subset.

tests.explanation: Taking two and four earns six.
Taking all threes earns nine, better than taking twos and four.
